title: Sophia Hatsell
text:
Hello! I am currently a graduate student at the USC Department of Mathematics. I graduated from UCLA in 2025 with a Bachelors in Mathematics and a Specialization in Computing.
Before I started grad school, I was a Technical Solutions Engineer at Epic Systems on the Patient Experience team.
